requirements.summary: Publish/deploy application Version 17 to the live environment and ensure it is the active version served to users.
acceptanceCriteria: Version 17 is deployed to the live environment and is the active version served to users
A live URL (or confirmation of the existing live URL) is provided for verification

file_operations.description: Add deployment-only runbook for promoting Version 17 to the live environment, using the repository’s existing deployment tooling. Use the github-export-icp-cli component to support production deployment workflow (Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing). Ensure the runbook explicitly states no application functionality/code changes are part of this request.

Add a small static metadata file to record the deployed version label (Version 17), deployment timestamp, and the confirmed live URL for verification. This is a documentation/verification artifact only and must not change application behavior.
